continuationGovernor.stopReason: The real issuedonce.shop customer journey remains live-proven through encrypted shipping and the application stays fail-closed before payment. Queue replay hardening is green, and the Printful manufacturing boundary has now been hardened with failing-first evidence so an owner confirmation cannot charge while printable artwork is unprocessed, cannot confirm a remote order that is no longer a true draft, cannot accept a 200 confirmation unless the exact provider order reaches pending, and cannot misclassify remote failed/onhold states as a local DRAFT. The final Printful state-policy fix is commit 3c20e8a46e9137abc4694e7cfd9741ef45ca1fe5. CI run 32405563664 and Browser QA run 32405563688 both succeeded, including the live production customer journey. Safepay sandbox credentials and endpoint registration remain the first genuine external owner gate and cannot be completed through the currently available connected tooling.
